evidence.value:
usage: pydicom deidentify [-h] --crosswalk CROSSWALK
                          [--patient-prefix PATIENT_PREFIX]
                          [--profile PROFILE]
                          input_dir output_dir

Report what a release would contain, without writing one.

positional arguments:
  input_dir
  output_dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --crosswalk CROSSWALK
  --patient-prefix PATIENT_PREFIX
  --profile PROFILE
